title: Page Access (RBAC)
description: Page x role access matrix for EquipRite. Rows = pages grouped by module, columns = FULL / READ_ONLY / HIDDEN for the selected role. One Save for the whole grid, scoped to the selected app role.

rolesArray.description: Active RBAC_APP_ROLES rows for EQUIP_RITE, from getRbacAppRoles. Read from the table rather than hard-coded so a newly seeded role appears with no frontend change.

selectedRoleId.description: APP_ROLE_ID currently being edited. Every save is scoped to this and must never touch another role's rows.

matrixArray.description: Rows for the selected role as last loaded from the server (the clean baseline). Never mutated by edits — dirtyMap holds pending changes so Cancel is a no-op and Save can send only what changed.

dirtyMap.description: Pending edits { pageCode: 'FULL'|'READ_ONLY'|'HIDDEN' } not yet saved. Separate from matrixArray so the grid can show pending state while Cancel still reverts cleanly.

loadError.description: Non-empty when the matrix or role list failed to load. The grid stays hidden rather than showing a misleadingly empty matrix.
